basic_details.job_title: THSTI Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 3 Project Associate I, Project Associate II Posts
basic_details.short_information: THSTI is holding walk-in interviews on 14 December 2026 and 15 December 2026, with a 9:00 am walk-in for written test/skill test/interview at THSTI, NCR Biotech Science Cluster, 3rd Milestone, Faridabad-Gurugram Expressway, Faridabad – 121001. Three project posts are open under Rolling Recruitment Notice No. THS/RN/01/2026/11-II: one Project Associate-I and two Project Associate-II. Pay is Rs. 31,000 or Rs. 25,000 plus HRA for Project Associate-I, and Rs. 42,000 or Rs. 33,000 plus HRA for Project Associate-II, depending on the candidate's category of selection described below.

content_sections.heading: About THSTI
content_sections.text: THSTI runs its campus at the NCR Biotech Science Cluster on the Faridabad-Gurugram Expressway in Faridabad. The three posts sit in research projects at the institute, and the notice describes them as short-term positions. Each post is tied to a named project and principal investigator (PI), given below.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Project: Inter-Institutional program for Maternal, Neonatal and Infant Sciences – A Translational approach – interdisciplinary Group for Advanced Research on BirtH outcomes – DBT INdia Initiative (GARBHINI Phase-II). PIs: Dr. Nitya Wadhwa and Dr. Bhabatosh Das. Walk-in date: 14 December 2026. Candidates should have a strong background in bacterial genetics, or microbiology with demonstrated hands-on experience in microbial culture, gene sequencing, and genome analysis. Project: Bioengineered Amniotic Membrane Hydrogel for the treatment of ocular surface diseases. PI: Dr. Santosh S. Mathapati. Walk-in date: 14 December 2026. Desirable: proficiency in cell and molecular biology techniques such as ELISA, real-time PCR, immunocytochemistry, and fluorescence microscopy. Desirable: experience with preclinical research (small animals) workflows, preferably in drug testing and therapeutic evaluation studies. Desirable: highly motivated, enthusiastic, and hardworking individual with strong teamwork and interpersonal skills. Project: CHO cell engineering for improving cell growth and recombinant protein productivity. PI: Dr. Niraj Kumar. Walk-in date: 15 December 2026. The higher amount, Rs. 31,000/- + HRA for Project Associate-I and Rs. 42,000/- + HRA for Project Associate-II, is for scholars selected through (a) National Eligibility Tests – CSIR – UGC NET including lectureship or GATE, or (b) a selection process through national level examinations conducted by Central Department and their agencies and institutions. Others who do not fall under that group get Rs. 25,000/- + HRA for Project Associate-I and Rs. 33,000/- + HRA for Project Associate-II. The age limit for all three posts is 35 years. The date of interview of the respective post is the crucial date for determining eligibility for age, experience, essential qualification and similar criteria. The notice states that all educational, professional and technical qualifications should be from a recognized Board/University. Experience counts only if acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualification specified for the post. Candidates are required to satisfy themselves about the minimum eligibility criteria before appearing, and no query will be entertained on eligibility. Discipline-specific eligibility of each post is as printed in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: THSTI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Perform routine maintenance and characterisation of cell lines. Perform and assist in animal drug testing studies, including dosing, monitoring, sample collection, and necropsy procedures. Maintain accurate laboratory records, documentation, logbooks, and inventory management. Ensure compliance with laboratory safety, biosafety regulations, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Provide support to laboratory colleagues in routine laboratory and research activities. Skills required: Cell Culture, Electrophoresis, Western blotting, PCR/ qPCR and ELISA. The notice prints no duties or skills column entry for Project Associate-I.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Latest CV/resume. One set of photocopies of documents in support of educational qualification and experience, along with the originals. A valid ID card for verification.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates walk in at 9:00 am on the date shown against the post for written test/skill test/interview. Candidates coming after the time slot mentioned will not be entertained. All candidates coming for the written test/skill test/interview must deposit their mobile phone along with valid identity proof at the reception. The phone is returned only on completion of the entire selection process. If many candidates appear, screening will be done to limit the number to those possessing higher/relevant qualification and experience.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: These are short-term positions. Extension will be granted subject to satisfactory performance of the incumbents and the tenure of the project. Appointees will not have any claim for regularization of employment. The number of vacancies may change subject to the actual requirement at the time of the written test/skill test/interview. All results and notifications will be published only on the THSTI website, and all communications will be made only through email. Canvassing wrong information in any form will be a disqualification. Provisions not covered in the notification are governed by the bye-laws of THSTI and Govt. of India rules/guidelines. The notice states that women candidates are encouraged to apply.

faq.question: Q1. When is the THSTI walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in is on 14 December 2026 for Project Associate-I and one Project Associate-II post, and on 15 December 2026 for the other Project Associate-II post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue?
faq.answer: Candidates walk in at 9:00 am at THSTI, NCR Biotech Science Cluster, 3rd Milestone, Faridabad-Gurugram Expressway, Faridabad – 121001.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 3 posts: one Project Associate-I and two Project Associate-II. The notice says the number may change with the actual requirement at the time of the test/interview.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: All three posts need a Master's degree in any branch of Life Sciences from a recognized university. Project Associate-II also needs at least two years of post-qualification experience, in biomaterials and cell culture biology or in molecular biology, depending on the project.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years for all posts, counted on the date of interview of the respective post. SC/ST get 5 years and OBC 3 years of relaxation, with further relaxations for PwBD, Central Government servants, institute employees and ex-servicemen as listed above.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Project Associate posts?
faq.answer: Project Associate-I gets Rs. 31,000/- + HRA or Rs. 25,000/- + HRA, and Project Associate-II gets Rs. 42,000/- + HRA or Rs. 33,000/- + HRA, depending on whether the scholar was selected through CSIR-UGC NET, GATE or a national level examination.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, every pay amount in the notice is written as an amount plus HRA, for example Rs. 25,000/- + HRA.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should I bring?
faq.answer: Bring the latest CV/resume, one set of photocopies of educational qualification and experience documents with the originals, and a valid ID card.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through a written test/skill test/interview at THSTI. If many candidates appear, screening limits the number to those with higher or relevant qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, these are short-term positions. Extension depends on satisfactory performance and the project tenure, and appointees have no claim for regularization.
